## Timestamp Resolution & Point-in-Time Invariants

- [x] CHK001 Are timestamp unit conversion requirements explicitly specified for all supported `DatetimeIndex` resolutions (`s`, `ms`, `us`, `ns`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is the strict monotonicity and duplicate-free ordering requirement (`t[i] > t[i-1]`) clearly defined for the TradingView chart payload? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are backward-compatibility requirements documented for existing `.cache/parquet/` files containing `datetime64[ms, UTC]` or `datetime64[us, UTC]` indices? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]

## TradingView Canvas Serialization & Layout Quality

- [x] CHK006 Are responsive container sizing requirements specified for the HTML5 chart inside tabbed dashboard layouts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]

## Provider & Timeframe Switching Coverage
